answer: An agent marketplace gives each account voting power proportional to its locked collateral, with a 30-day withdrawal delay. An attacker splitting 100 tokens among agents named tundra, crystal, and comet still gets only 100 tokens of voting power; creating more identities adds none. To gain influence, the attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, tying up capital for at least 30 days instead of merely generating free accounts.
